denominator: All scored attempts for each model. Patterns overlap and can occur on successful attempts; the self-check/hidden-test mismatch is failure-only by definition.

modes.name: tool_call_protocol
modes.label: Invalid action format
modes.definition: Most turns rejected because the action is emitted in a function-call format (<tool_call>, name/arguments, bare keystroke objects) instead of terminus-2 JSON
modes.detector: taxonomy flag true_protocol: >=30% of turns truly rejected (post-thinking body not a valid action) and >=3
modes.precision: 10/10 (taxonomy validation of the protocol label); 73% of base0921's 59,119 rejected turns contain <tool_call>

modes.name: runaway_thinking_cap
modes.label:
Turn reaches the
16k-token limit
modes.definition: A single turn generates to the 16k output cap (thinking runaway); the turn is truncated and usually rejected
modes.precision: exact by construction (token count); as primary timeout cause 5/7 (taxonomy validation)

modes.name: handoff_reexploration
modes.label:
3+ summarization
handoffs
modes.definition: Context fills repeatedly (>=3 summarization handoffs); after each the model re-reads files it already explored
modes.precision: 53/60 sampled flagged failures repeat an earlier command within 3 turns of a handoff

modes.name: unterminated_heredoc_wedge
modes.label:
Shell stuck in an
unfinished command
modes.definition: A heredoc/quote is never closed, the shell sits at a '> ' continuation prompt and swallows later commands
modes.detector: >=2 accepted turns whose terminal output ends at a '> ' continuation prompt not opened by that turn's own heredoc
modes.precision: 6/6 read (mismatched terminator EOF vs PYEOF, unbalanced quotes)

modes.name: own_check_misses_spec
modes.label:
Own check passes,
hidden test fails
modes.definition: Model runs its own check after the last edit, the check looks fine, hidden tests fail (spec detail its check did not test)
